{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
#FLUX -C haswell
#FLUX -J test_driver
#FLUX --qos=regular
#FLUX -t 40:00:00
#FLUX --nodes=9

# NOTE: The --mail-user and --mail-type directives have been omitted as Flux
# does not have a direct equivalent for job status email notifications.

# NOTE: The 'salloc' command from the original script has been removed. `salloc` is
# used to interactively allocate resources, which is not a meaningful operation
# within a non-interactive batch script. The batch script itself serves as the
# resource allocation request.

module load python/3.7-anaconda-2019.10

module unload cray-mpich
module unload cmake
module load cmake/3.14.4

module unload PrgEnv-intel
module load PrgEnv-gnu

export MKLROOT=/opt/intel/compilers_and_libraries_2019.3.199/linux/mkl
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH:/opt/intel/compilers_and_libraries_2019.3.199/linux/mkl/lib/intel64
BLAS_LIB="${MKLROOT}/lib/intel64/libmkl_gf_lp64.so;${MKLROOT}/lib/intel64/libmkl_gnu_thread.so;${MKLROOT}/lib/intel64/libmkl_core.so;-lgomp"
LAPACK_LIB="${MKLROOT}/lib/intel64/libmkl_gf_lp64.so;${MKLROOT}/lib/intel64/libmkl_gnu_thread.so;${MKLROOT}/lib/intel64/libmkl_core.so;-lgomp"

# module use /global/common/software/m3169/cori/modulefiles
# module unload openmpi
module load openmpi/4.0.1
export PYTHONPATH=~/.local/cori/3.7-anaconda-2019.10/lib/python3.7/site-packages
export PYTHONPATH=$PYTHONPATH:$PWD/autotune/
export PYTHONPATH=$PYTHONPATH:$PWD/scikit-optimize/
export PYTHONPATH=$PYTHONPATH:$PWD/mpi4py/
export PYTHONPATH=$PYTHONPATH:$PWD/GPTune/
export PYTHONWARNINGS=ignore

CCC=mpicc
CCCPP=mpicxx
FTN=mpif90

cd ~/GPTune/examples/minimalcGP/
pip install -r requirements.txt --user

# The original script contained a commented-out mpirun command. It has been
# translated to a commented-out 'flux run' command.
# flux run -n 1 python cGP_constrained.py 123 30 1.0 0 4 3 10 SI2.bin


export PATH="/global/homes/h/hrluo/.local/cori/3.7-anaconda-2019.10/bin:$PATH" 

echo 'cGP superLU experiment environment setup finished...'


sh run_matrix.sh Na5.bin


echo 'cGP superLU experiment done!'
"
}

issues: The job requests 9 nodes but does not specify how many tasks to run (`--ntasks`, `--ntasks-per-node`). The script's main workload is a single shell script (`sh run_matrix.sh`) that is not launched with a parallel runner like `flux run`. This will result in the entire job running as a single serial process on only one of the 9 allocated nodes, leaving 8 nodes completely idle. This represents a massive waste of resources. The resource request should be reduced to `#FLUX --nodes=1` and an appropriate task count (e.g., `--ntasks=1`) to match the serial nature of the workload.
